'''Alexandre Dufresne Beat Down Time''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Alexandre Dufresne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10016">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10016 Beat Down Time], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 30 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10016/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10016/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125635/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10016/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alexandre Dufresne]]
* '''Published:''' 30 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Beat Down Time''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 BDT Dufresne LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' The deck is simple drain when needed and build up your forces and defeat you opponent.

== Original post ==

'''Beat Down Time'''
* '''Author:''' Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne
* '''Published:''' August 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' The deck is simple drain when needed and build up your forces and defeat you opponent.

=== Strategy ===

The main Idea Behined This deck to is to beat the snot out of your opponent. You use the Enhanced characters like Luke and Han, to defend the ground and intiate battles, the star ships to do a beat down in space and Oola to keep the opponents unique male characters in his hand. That makes it easier on you and you then have less characters to worry about and can focus on a space beat down and force draining on the ground.

PS. For this deck only start a batttle if you would have the advantage.
